caption: The drawing depicts a single brown leather shoe shown in a side profile, occupying the lower right part of the image. The shoe has a closed toe, low stacked heel, and a simple upper with a subtle seam at the side. The interior lining of the shoe is a lighter tan color. Above the shoe, in the upper left portion of the drawing, are two outline sketches in pencil: one shows a top view of the same shoe model with visible stitching and holes for laces, while the other shows the sole of the shoe with an outline for the heel and forefoot. The background is a plain off-white color, fading into a slightly darker tone toward the top edge.
title: Man's Shoe
